explanation: `\\` starts a new line, and TeX found one right at the start of a paragraph — there was nothing on the current line for it to end. This usually means an extra `\\` was left behind after moving or deleting text; delete it, or use `\vspace{...}` instead if the point was only to add space.
rawMessage: LaTeX Error: There's no line here to end.
title: A line break with nothing on the line yet
